cues.voiceover: Thinking about an earthship or an off-grid homestead?
cues.onScreen: Plan your off-grid home before you pour a foundation.

cues.voiceover: R&B's Homesteading walks you through the six systems every one depends on: shelter, heat, power, water, waste, and food.
cues.onScreen: Six systems. One plan. Water, power, heat, shelter, waste, and food.

cues.voiceover: Start with the climate you'll actually live in, because these homes work best where days swing hot to cold and the air stays dry.
Install R&B's Homesteading on your phone or desktop, and keep your plan with you.

extra.headline: Plan your off-grid home before you pour a foundation.
extra.subhead: Six systems. One plan. Water, power, heat, shelter, waste, and food.

cards.title: Shelter
cards.text: Natural and repurposed materials; earth-sheltered walls swing less than air.

cards.title: Heat
cards.text: Glass wall faces the equator for winter sun; roof and north, east, west walls are heavily insulated.

cards.title: Power
cards.text: Solar and wind power the house.

cards.title: Water
cards.text: Roof water is harvested into a cistern and reused in stages.

cards.title: Food
cards.text: Food production is built into the design.

extra.caveat: Soil is about R-1 per foot; thermal mass is not insulation. Check your local rules.
